ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast ratio; visible surface is predominantly low-intensity (black) with minimal high-intensity (white) pixel distribution estimated at <5%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark pigmentation across the entirety of both lobes; absence of macro-level mottling or banding; sparse distribution of isolated white pixel clusters (speckles) primarily on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch with a sharp interior convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; left lobe exhibits 4-5 distinct jagged peaks; right lobe presents a complex, multi-amplitude serration profile increasing in frequency toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the central median notch tapering upward and outward to elevated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized high-contrast (white) circular pixel clusters: approx. 6-8 units on the mid-right lobe and 2-3 units near the trailing edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small circular white focal points consistent with parasitic scarring on the right fluke; highly irregular/jagged distal tip on the far left edge suggesting historical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high-amplitude serration and irregular pixel density at the far distal tips of both lobes relative to the rest of the trailing edge.
